`final class Lwjgl2GlBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.lwjgl2.opengl` · **Module:** `base-lwjgl2` · **Source:** [Lwjgl2GlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/lwjgl2/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/lwjgl2/opengl/Lwjgl2GlBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span>

The OpenGL binding of LWJGL 2, which calls the classes `GL11` to `GL33`.

## Description

The LWJGL 2 backend gives it to [`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/), and so does a host that runs on the OpenGL of LWJGL 2.

## Learn more

- [base-lwjgl2](/build/base-modules/lwjgl2/#bindings)
- [Create the bridge](/build/base-modules/opengl/#create-the-bridge)
- [LWJGL 2 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl2/)
- [Embedding in a host](/build/embedding-in-a-host/)

<a id="Lwjgl2GlBinding-method-texSubImage2D"></a>

### texSubImage2D

`void texSubImage2D(int target, int level, int x, int y, int width, int height, int format, int type, int[] pixels)` 

Calls `glTexSubImage2D` through a direct buffer of a million pixels that it reuses, in bands of rows for a larger image.

### drawArrays

`void drawArrays(int mode, int first, int count)` 

Calls `glDrawArrays`.

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
